title: Chapter 9
text: There is no moment as rewarding, as stirring, as…anticlimactic as a Riders Quadrant Graduation. It’s the only time I’ve ever envied the Infantry Quadrant. Now those cadets know how to hold a ceremony. —M AJOR A FENDRA’S G UIDE TO THE R IDERS Q UADRANT (U NAUTHORIZED E DITION )
